profile.visual_desc: Sturdy human in teal tunics and a brown cloak. Wears a teal turban with a blue gemstone and carries a back-mounted quiver.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Stern, tanned face shadowed by a teal hood. Features a prominent blue circular jewel and a focused, stoic expression.
profile.weapon_desc: Large black recurve bow held in the left hand, firing silver-tipped arrows.
profile.step1_ready: Standing in a 3/4 view facing down-right, nocking an arrow into a horizontally tilted bow.
profile.step2_windup: Draws the bowstring back fully, aiming rightward, then releases the projectile in a sharp motion.
profile.step3_impact: The arrow streaks right with a motion trail. Character shifts to a vertical bow stance, hand near the hood.
profile.step4_finish: Holds a stationary recovery pose with the bow upright as the projectile clears the area.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The linear arrow projectile trajectory in the top-right frame aligns perfectly with the bow's horizontal release angle.

evaluation.diagnosis: The 10-frame animation successfully expands upon the 6-frame reference. The wind-up phase (F0-F4) shows a smooth draw of the bow string, the projectile release (F5-F7) maintains perfect horizontal alignment with the weapon, and the follow-through (F8-F9) settles the character back to an idle state without any biomechanical or visual glitches.
